Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:10 AM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija and Bataan(Morong, Dinalupihan, Hermosa).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Batangas, Quezon, Cavite, Rizal, Laguna and Bataan(Abucay, Bagac, Balanga, Limay, Mariveles, Orani, Orion, Pilar, Samal) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
